en.ammaar-muslim: 3. [3/373] al-Kafi: Muhammad b. Yahya from Ahmad b. Muhammad from Ibn Abi Umayr from Abd al-Rahman b. al-Hajjaj from Sulayman b. Khalid who said:
Abu Abdillah عليه السلام said: Allah Mighty and Majestic says: “and to your Lord is the End (finality)” [53:42] so if your talks reach to Allah then remain silent.
